2608.02515.title: LiveMem: Maintaining Memory State Continuity in Long-Running LLM Inference
2608.02515.paper_summary: Long-running assistants and agents consume interaction streams that eventually outgrow the context. Existing context retention, summarization, and retrieval preserve access to selected history, but do not provide a persistent state over the full lifecycle when working context changes. We formulate this missing inference capability as \emph{state continuity under context turnover}: carrying computation forward through a fixed-capacity memory state whose lifetime is independent of the active context. We introduce an intrinsic memory method, \textbf{LiveMem}, which augments a pretrained full-attention LLM with a memory state that preserves the historical information over the whole lifecycle while the main attention path retains a bounded KV window. Context turnover and memory state maintaining, memory-oriented post-training, and state-aware serving jointly make this memory state load bearing after its originating tokens are released. Our experiments show that LiveMem achieves leading overall performance among evaluated systems and other intrinsic memory methods. Experiments on LongMemEval show that LiveMem is able to answer the question based on the memory state, even when the supporting evidence has been removed from the current context, and evidence-distance analysis shows that useful information persists beyond the active window. LiveMem thus establishes state continuity as a distinct and complementary abstraction for continual LLM inference.
2608.02515.paper_summary_zh: 長期運行的助手和代理會消耗互動流，這些流最終會超出上下文的範圍。現有的上下文保留、摘要和檢索技術雖然能夠保留對選定歷史的訪問，但在工作上下文變化時並未提供持久狀態。我們將這一缺失的推理能力定義為\emph{在上下文變更下的狀態連續性}：通過一個固定容量的記憶狀態將計算向前推進，其壽命與當前上下文無關。我們介紹了一種內在記憶方法\textbf{LiveMem}，它增強了一個預訓練的全注意力LLM，並配備了一個保留整個生命周期歷史信息的記憶狀態，同時主要的注意力路徑保持一個有限的KV窗口。上下文變更和記憶狀態維護、以記憶為導向的後訓練以及狀態感知服務共同使得這個記憶狀態在其原始標記釋放後仍能承載負載。我們的實驗顯示，LiveMem在評估的系統和其他內在記憶方法中實現了領先的整體性能。在LongMemEval上的實驗顯示，LiveMem能夠根據記憶狀態回答問題，即使支持證據已從當前上下文中移除，證據距離分析顯示有用的信息在活動窗口之外仍然存在。因此，LiveMem確立了狀態連續性作為持續LLM推理的一個獨特且互補的抽象。
